source.title: Forebears Gabon forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. Gender grouping follows public gender-majority data for high-frequency forenames and is not an official civil registry dataset; surnames were cross-filled from https://forebears.io/gabon/surnames.

source.title: ITU Operational Bulletin: Gabon national numbering plan communication of 21.V.2019

phones.notes: ITU/ARCEP confirms country code +241, eight-digit international significant numbers after dropping the domestic trunk 0, and mobile NDCs 62/65/66 for Gabon Telecom Libertis/Moov plus 74/77 for Airtel Gabon. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Gabon addressing examples using BP/P.O. Box delivery and locality/delivery-office lines, including Libreville and Tchibanga examples. Province-city links use public administrative geography, while street lists and fixed three-digit BP suffixes are synthetic samples and not official postal allocations.

personal_identification_number.label: Personal Identification Number (NIP)
personal_identification_number.notes: The official Ministry of Interior source confirms NIP issuance as the prerequisite for the electronic national identity card. The ID4Africa project presentation and public examples indicate a XX-NNNN-YYYYMMDD structure; generated values omit separators, use the profile birth date, and keep the first two alphanumeric characters synthetic because the control algorithm is not public.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Gabon ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Gabon ordinary passport document versions. The public PRADO category reviewed does not confirm a passport number grammar, so this template is only a synthetic placeholder and does not reuse a single specimen as a public rule.
